New model

Tencent releases Hy4 flash

17 November 2026 · Reading time: 7 minutes

Tencent has published Hy4 flash, its most cost-effective Hy model to date, as open weights on Hugging Face. The model takes text and images, has a context window of up to 1 million tokens and is aimed at everyday office work.

Sapaude retells the story in its own words. The source is below. Publisher: Sapaude.

In three points

Three points, in this order: what the source shows, where that claim stops, and what to check next.

  1. Hy4 flash has 220 billion parameters in total, 64 billion of them in a component Tencent calls Engram, but only about 12 billion are active per token. Tencent released an instruct model, an FP8 version and a base model.
  2. On WorkIndex, Tencent's internal benchmark, it scores 42.1 against 39.7 for Hy4 preview, at about a thirteenth of the cost per task. These are Tencent's own figures.
  3. The Tencent Hy License is based on Apache 2.0 but adds terms: large companies that offer the model to others as a service need a separate written license.

Tencent releases Hy4 flash

Tencent has released Hy4 flash as open weights. The repository on Hugging Face went up on November 17, alongside copies on ModelScope and GitCode. Tencent calls it its most cost-effective Hy model to date. Three versions are available: the instruct model for chat and tasks, an FP8-quantized instruct model and the pre-trained Hy4 flash-base. According to Tencent, the base model is not instruction-tuned, and the chat examples apply only to the other two.

Tencent recommends Hy4 flash for most everyday productivity tasks: deep search, document processing, slide creation, simple frontend demos and computer use. For complex work such as long-horizon software engineering, it points to the larger Hy4, which has a higher ceiling.

220 billion parameters, 12 billion active

Hy4 flash is a mixture-of-experts model with 220 billion parameters in total. About 64 billion of them sit in Engram, a set of learned bigram and trigram representations that are retrieved through hash lookups. Only about 12 billion parameters are active per token: each token activates 16 of 512 routed experts plus one shared expert. The model natively accepts text and images, generates text and handles a context window of up to 1,048,576 tokens.

Other design choices also target cost. Sparse attention and sliding-window attention alternate at a ratio of one to three. Together with the expert design and Engram, Tencent says, this shrinks the KV cache to a sixth of Hy4's. A built-in drafter called DFly2, with 0.85 billion parameters, speeds up generation through speculative decoding. Combined with 4-bit quantization and megakernels, Tencent reports decoding speeds above 150 tokens per second. Reinforcement learning halved the average output length, the company says.

Tencent's numbers and the license

The performance claims come from Tencent. On WorkIndex, an internal benchmark built on typical WorkBuddy tasks, Hy4 flash scores 42.1, compared with 39.7 for Hy4 preview and 51.4 for Hy4. Tencent puts its average cost per task at a thirteenth of Hy4 preview and a twentieth of Hy4. In a blind evaluation with 85 internal users, satisfaction came in at 2.79 out of 4, close to Claude Haiku 5.5 at 2.81.

The model is released under the Tencent Hy License 1.0. It is derived from Apache 2.0 but, as the text itself states, is not the Apache license. Section 10 adds commercial terms for Model-as-a-Service businesses. Anyone who gives third parties remote access, for example through an API, needs a separate written license from Tencent if the company's worldwide revenue exceeds 50 million US dollars in any 12-month period, or if the product has more than 100 million monthly active users. Purely internal use is exempt, as are end-user products that only use the model for specific features. Fine-tuned and quantized versions count as derivative works.

What running it takes

Hy4 flash is a model for servers. The instruct weights on Hugging Face total about 440 GB, the FP8 version about 287 GB. Tencent's examples for vLLM and SGLang spread the FP8 model across eight GPUs. Support in Transformers has not yet been merged into the main branch; until then, Tencent points to a specific pull request. For testing, there is a compressed GGUF version, and the repository includes a guide for fine-tuning.

What you can do

Hy4 flash puts a large Tencent model built for low running costs in the hands of anyone with the hardware to host it. Tencent recommends it for everyday tasks and the larger Hy4 for long software projects; the cost and quality figures are still Tencent's own.

In the app, the same story is also told shorter and in more detail, matched to your level.
